capabilities: Register journal entries in Markdown code blocks using custom tags (acj, acj-m, acl)
Render entries in traditional Spanish journal and T-account ledger formats
Convert journal and ledger blocks into static HTML previews inside the note
Load a custom chart of accounts from a CSV file to display account names
disambiguation: Not a full accounting system; it only renders simple educational journal and ledger entries, not payroll, taxes, or logic-heavy rule generation.
extras: Converted entries become static HTML and can no longer be edited from within the block.
motivation: Built for recording simple journal entries in class and creating example entries easily for accounting education.
problem: Obsidian has no way to display double-entry bookkeeping entries (libro diario and libro mayor) in a clear, presentation-ready format inside notes.
summary: Accounting education plugin that renders double-entry journal and ledger entries written in Markdown code blocks into formatted tables and HTML.
